<thought>Using the monoisotopic mass from the protonated ion (m/z 276.0666) and subtracting a proton gives a neutral mass of ~275.0593 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+2 ≈ 34 % of M) suggests the presence of two chlorine atoms. Subtracting the mass of two 35Cl atoms (2 × 34.968852 Da) leaves ~205.1216 Da for C, H, and O. Adding two oxygens (2 × 15.994915 Da) leaves ~173.1317 Da, which is satisfied by 13 carbons (13 × 12.0000 Da) and 17 hydrogens (17 × 1.007825 Da). This gives a calculated exact mass of 275.0606 Da, within ~1 mDa of the observed mass, confirming the formula.> 
<final_answer>C13H17O2Cl2</final_answer>
